name: Mimi (Dry Snack)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard oil or vegetable oil
1 teaspoon red chili powder (or crushed dried red chilies)
instructions: 1. Remove the noodles from the packet and crush them into bite-sized pieces in a bowl.
2. Heat the mustard oil in a small pan until smoking point and let it cool slightly.
3. Add the turmeric, red chili powder, cumin, and coriander powder to the oil to bloom the spices.
4. Pour this spiced oil over the crushed noodles.
5. Add the finely chopped onions, green chilies, and salt.
6. Mix everything vigorously until the noodles are well coated with the spice mix.
7. Serve immediately as a crunchy snack, garnished with fresh coriander.
description: Mimi is a quintessential 'after-school' or 'tea-time' snack in Sikkim. Reflecting the influence of instant noodle culture in the Himalayan regions, this dish elevates a simple convenience food into a flavorful, textured experience that captures the local preference for spicy and pungent seasoning.
